newsitem.title: JAPAN: Orix seeks to list shares in New York in autumn 98.
newsitem.headline: Orix seeks to list shares in New York in autumn 98.

text.p: Major Japanese leasing company Orix Corp said on Wednesday that it is seeking to list its shares in New York in autumn of 1998.

"Our shares will be listed (in New York) as early as autumn 1998. We will prepare for the listing based on our earnings for the year to March 31, 1998," an Orix spokesman said. The spokesman did not give a forecast for 1997/98 earnings.
A listing in New York is part of Orix's efforts to become a global company and is expected to allow it to diversify its fund-raising sources, the company spokesman said.
Orix's shares are listed in Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya.
